main_text.p: cutoriam, quàm per Diffinitivam, provocandi via omnibus v-biq; aperta est & libera.

p.i: c. ut debitus 59 & c.cessante. 60. c.super eo 12. h.t.c. non ita. 2.q.6.c.1.c. Romana 3.h.t.in 16.c.appellanti 5. in Clem. Eod. Marant.h.t. n.303. Lanfr. de Oriano in pra.iud.d.cap. 10. n.60. Gail.1.obs.119. Menoch. de arb. iud.quaest. q.70 n.5. Pet. Gregor. Syntag. Iur. d. lib. 50.c.2.n.2.

main_text.p: In feudalibus eodem omnino modo, quo in aliis causis, appellatio institui debet: nisi Ius feudale, aliaq; consuetudo aliter de his disponat.

p.i: cap.fin.lib.1.feud.tit.Quo temp.mil.inuest.pet.deb. Mynsing. Cent.5.obs.5. Gail.1.obs.156.n.3. Eatenus enim Ius communein iis causis sequimur, quatenus de iure feudali contrarium non reperitur decisum, c.1. verf.si strenuus lib.2.de feud. cognit.

main_text.p: Ab actionibus Extrajudicialibus eatenus appellatio institui potest, quatenus formam aut vim sententiæ iudicialis habent; aut quatenus alias etiam extra ordinem Iudicis officium implorare permissum est.

p.i: Bart. in l.fin.ff de appel.recip.l.1.§.solent.ff.Quand.appel.fit.l.5. C. Quorum appel.non recip.c.cum sit Romana h.t.t.t. C. de Relat. Mynsf. Cent.4. obs.43. VVesenb. in par.ff.h.t.n.8. Specul.h.t.§. restat.

main_text.p: In factis notoriis, {a} in causis breuioribus, {b} friuolis, {c} invalidis, {d} aliisq; rebus quæ dilationem non recipiunt, {e} appellatio neutiquam concedi debet.

{a} In quibus non distinguitur, sive neget aliquis, sive confiteatur: nec enim negatio inficit notorium, neq; etiam rem dubiam reddit. Gail.1.obs.31.n.6.per c.super 13.de testib. & attest.c. consuluit 14. h.t.Rob.Marant. h.t n.293.

{b} De iure ciuili, secus de iure Canonico, per tex.in c.de appellationibus 11. h.t. not. Marant. h.t. n.326. post Card. & Abbat. in d. c. appellationibus: Diversitatis ratio affertur, in c. anteriores §.illud etiam,2.q.6.auth.nisi breuiores C. de sententi. exper.

page.notes: The first line ends "v-" with "biq;" below, so the word is "ubiq" broken at the line end. The "[?]" marks were not needed for the printed words. Doubtful readings: "Mynsf." (Cent.4 citation), possibly an abbreviation of Mynsinger, and "sententi." (end of note b), read as printed with a truncated word. Long s is rendered as s throughout. The reference marks {a} to {e} keep their printed letters, with the parenthesis dropped. The catchword "exper." appears at the right below the last line.
